story.titleZh: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁已将其F1车队的少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。约翰逊是强生制药帝国的继承人，也是NFL球队纽约喷气机队的老板，去年还收购了英超球队水晶宫的主要股份。
story.originalTitle: US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson acquires minor Aston Martin F1 stake
story.summaryEn: Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman. Johnson, an heir of the Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical empire, also owns the New York Jets NFL team and acquired a major stake in Premier League football team Crystal Palace last year.
detailZh: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
纽约喷气机队老板、唐纳德·特朗普的捐助者、前美国驻英国大使罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊已收购阿斯顿·马丁一级方程式车队的少数股权
伍迪·约翰逊已收购这支英国车队的少数股权
阿斯顿·马丁已将其一级方程式车队的少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。
约翰逊是强生制药帝国的继承人，还拥有NFL球队纽约喷气机队，并于去年收购了英超足球俱乐部水晶宫的主要股份。
这位79岁的老人是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的长期捐助者，并在特朗普当选后于2017年至2021年期间担任美国驻英国大使。
约翰逊现已被阿斯顿·马丁老板劳伦斯·斯特罗尔引入，以推动这支银石车队在美国的商业增长，美国对这项系列赛来说是一个重要市场。车队强调约翰逊不会参与车队的日常管理。
约翰逊表示：“在我担任美国驻英国大使期间，我对阿斯顿·马丁的悠久历史以及劳伦斯·斯特罗尔的战略眼光和企业家精神深表赞赏。”
“我很高兴能与他合作，为车队的持续发展做出贡献，并立志打造一个能够在赛车运动最高水平上竞争的组织。
“我们还共同致力于在美国扩大粉丝基础，让更多粉丝领略一级方程式的激情。”
斯特罗尔补充道：“我非常高兴欢迎伍迪加入阿斯顿·马丁大家庭。他的经验、热情和投资进一步巩固了我们的地位，帮助我们迈入竞争旅程的下一阶段。
“他对我们品牌的深刻理解，加上他对创新和商业机会的承诺，使他成为我们展望未来时的理想合作伙伴。”
detailEn: US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson acquires minor Aston Martin F1 stake
New York Jets owner, Donald Trump donor and former US ambassador to the UK Robert Wood Johnson has acquired a minority stake in the Aston Martin Formula 1 team
Woody Johnson has acquired a minority stake in the British team
Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman.
Johnson, an heir of the Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical empire, also owns the New York Jets NFL team and acquired a major stake in Premier League football team Crystal Palace last year.
The 79-year-old is a long-time donor of US president Donald Trump, and served as US ambassador to the UK between 2017 and 2021 following Trump's election.

Johnson has now been brought in by Aston owner Lawrence Stroll to advance the Silverstone team's commercial growth in the US, which is an important market for the series. The team stressed Johnson would not be involved in the team's daily management.

"During my time as US Ambassador to the United Kingdom, I have developed a deep appreciation for Aston Martin's rich history, as well as Lawrence Stroll’s strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit," Johnson said.
"I am excited to partner with him and contribute to the continued development of the team, with the ambition of building an organisation capable of competing at the very highest level of the sport.
"We also share a commitment to growing the fanbase in the United States and introducing even more fans to the excitement of Formula 1."

Stroll added: "I am extremely happy to welcome Woody to the Aston Martin family. His experience, passion and investment further strengthen our position as we enter the next phase of our competitive journey.
"His deep appreciation for our brand, combined with his commitment to innovation and commercial opportunity, makes him an ideal partner as we look to the future.”
keyPointsZh: 约翰逊曾于2017年至2021年担任美国驻英国大使，并且是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的长期捐助者。
阿斯顿·马丁老板劳伦斯·斯特罗尔引入约翰逊，旨在推动车队在美国这一重要市场的商业增长，但车队强调约翰逊不会参与日常管理。
约翰逊表示，他在担任美国驻英国大使期间对阿斯顿·马丁的悠久历史以及劳伦斯·斯特罗尔的战略眼光和企业家精神深表赞赏。
keyPointsEn: Johnson served as US ambassador to the UK between 2017 and 2021 and is a long-time donor of US president Donald Trump.
Aston owner Lawrence Stroll brought in Johnson to advance the team's commercial growth in the US, an important market, but the team stressed Johnson would not be involved in daily management.

Johnson said that during his time as US Ambassador to the UK, he developed a deep appreciation for Aston Martin's rich history, as well as Lawrence Stroll's strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit.

relatedItems.titleZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
relatedItems.summaryZh: F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，26岁的赫塔在从IndyCar转向F2的过程中遇到了比预期更大的困难，但他希望赫塔能够反弹。

media.altZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距 · 第 1 张

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
